scripts.db:generate-seed: supabase db dump --local --data-only -s public,auth -x auth.audit_log_entries -x auth.flow_state -x auth.identities -x auth.instances -x auth.mfa_amr_claims -x auth.mfa_challenges -x auth.mfa_factors -x auth.one_time_tokens -x auth.refresh_tokens -x auth.saml_providers -x auth.saml_relay_states -x auth.schema_migrations -x auth.sessions -x auth.sso_domains -x auth.sso_providers -x auth.oauth_clients -x auth.oauth_authorizations -x auth.oauth_consents -x auth.oauth_client_states -x auth.custom_oauth_providers -x auth.webauthn_credentials -x auth.webauthn_challenges -f supabase/seed.sql
scripts.db:generate-types: supabase gen types typescript --local --schema public > src/lib/database.types.ts
